attempts.summary: Set up /srv/data on node1 with application data, took an XFS reflink-based filesystem snapshot under /srv/.snapshots, modified /srv/data (deleted a file, edited another, added a new file), then restored /srv/data from the snapshot and verified the restored content is byte-for-byte identical (SHA-256 manifest match) to the snapshot. Completed the mandatory single-node restart protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id and data checksums, issued a backgrounded systemctl reboot whose ack returned before disconnection, polled until node1 was reachable again, confirmed the boot_id changed and uptime reset, and re-verified /srv/data's checksums still match the snapshot manifest post-restart.
